newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Feed group to tender for 54,000T US corn.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Feed group to tender for 54,000T US corn.

text.p: Taiwan's Members Feed Industry Group will tender on Tuesday for a 54,000-tonne shipment of U.S. No.2 corn, traders said on Monday.
One buyer from the Members Feed Industry Group said the group hoped that the apparent return of an unpredictable China to international corn market would push prices lower.
"We hope the corn export from China will change the recent bull trend on the futures market," he said.

Seoul traders said on Monday that five South Korean firms had bought 24,000 tonnes of Chinese corn through a private negotiation at $145 to $142 per tonne on cost-and-freight basis, lower than the market expected.
Taipei traders said the Chinese seemed welling to sell their corn at more competitive prices.
"Earlier, the market was saying that China wanted to export corn at about $170 per tonne, but prices are better now," a buyer at Taiwan's Hui Shung Corp said.
The Members Feed Industry Group's main buyers are Taiwan's Formosa Oilseed, Fomau Cereal, Morn Sun Feed Mill and Shin Tai Indusry.
